response.sql:
WITH grouped_data AS (
  SELECT tr.ordertypedist, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) as trans_count
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
  GROUP BY tr.ordertypedist
),
with_share AS (
  SELECT ordertypedist, trans_count,
    CAST(trans_count AS REAL) / SUM(trans_count) OVER () as share
  FROM grouped_data
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM with_share
)
SELECT ws.ordertypedist, ws.trans_count, ws.share, ws.share - b.avg_share as above_baseline
FROM with_share ws, baseline b
WHERE ws.share > b.avg_share;

assumptions.assumption: INNER JOIN interprets 'dropping any without a match' as keeping only advancedbehavior records that have a corresponding transaction.
When multiple advancedbehavior records link to the same transaction, that transaction is counted once (via COUNT(DISTINCT transreg)).
